text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Perfect. This magic potion will
get my
mind nice and sharp!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Some medicinal chameleon plant, some

brain-soothing chocolate, and finish it
off with a
sweet orange juice base! Talk
about a super
effective combo!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Drinking this is gonna make my genius
magic even
better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho isn't feeling well, so I let
her rest in
my office for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Leave me alone, will you? It's just a
magical
disturbance! It happens to
magical girls all the
time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I must've messed up that potion...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... My head hurts, so I'm gonna take
the day
off! Get a fluffy futon ready for
me, Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho laments over her
headache.
